source: DHM Islamic Studies Level 3 (ISL A3) · lesson 4. Rewritten for children from Dr. Hassan's lesson; facts and references kept.
topic: The key that opens the door of prayer

learn.en: Wudu is washing certain parts of the body in a set way, to get ready for prayer.
learn.title: What is wudu?

learn.en: Wudu is not a choice. The Prophet ﷺ said: “No prayer is accepted without purification.” (Muslim 224)
learn.title: No wudu, no prayer

learn.en: Allah commands wudu in the Qur'an, in Surat al-Māʾidah (5:6). The verse names the parts we must wash and wipe.
learn.title: From the Qur'an

learn.en: Niyyah is the intention in your heart: “I am doing this for Allah, to get ready to pray.” You do not need to say it out loud.
learn.title: Intention is in the heart

learn.en: “Actions are only by intentions.” (Bukhari 1) Before you start, check: clean water, clean body and clothes, clean prayer place.
learn.title: Before you start

quiz.en: Where do we make the intention?
True or false? A prayer without purification is accepted.
True or false? Wudu gets us ready for prayer.

think.q: Why do you think Allah wants us to be clean before we talk to Him in prayer?
think.a: Because prayer is a meeting with Allah — we come clean and ready, like visiting someone very special.

parents.summary: Wudu is Allah's command (Qur'an 5:6) and the key to prayer. It begins with a sincere intention in the heart.
parents.tip: Before wudu, whisper together: “For Allah, to get ready to pray.”
